title: Named ownership versus tested capability
method: Synthetic 25-dataset review.15 named owners imply 60% name coverage;9 with tested notification and correction imply 36% operational coverage. Categories are disjoint and definitions should remain stable across reviews.
alt: Named ownership versus tested capability. Operationally covered: 9 datasets; Name without process: 6 datasets; No named owner: 10 datasets. Illustrative values.
